about: Golden restatements for the Restate judge. Written, hashed and timestamped before the first run (golden.lock.json). Scored on the one label, the only thing validators compare. H1 to H3 are held out: no expected label, run once, never used to tune the prompt, their labels are reported exactly as they come out.
thread: Each case is its own thread on the deployed contract: the author opens it with the position P below and a 5 GEN deposit, the joiner joins with the same deposit, restates, the author contests, and judge runs the real consensus.
position: Quarterly stablecoin pay beats token pay for contributors. Token pay ties wages to the price and hides what the work really costs, and stable pay makes budgets simple. Alignment can come from a separate vesting grant.

cases.restatement: They say token pay makes wages swing with the token price and hides the true cost of the work, that stable pay makes budgets simple, and that alignment can come through a separate vesting grant.
